relationships.subject: ROCK inhibitors
relationships.evidence_quote: ROCK inhibitors achieved a statistically significant reduction in IOP at 3 months (mean difference: -9.32 mmHg, 95% CI: -17.02 to -1.62).

relationships.subject: ROCK inhibitors
relationships.evidence_quote: The most common adverse event was conjunctival hyperemia, with a pooled prevalence of 6% (95% CI: 3%-15%), followed by ocular pain and blurred vision.

key_findings: ROCK inhibitors produce significant, sustained IOP reduction in uveitic glaucoma and uveitis-related ocular hypertension (-9.32 mmHg at 3 months, -7.92 mmHg at 12 months).
Adverse events are mainly mild ocular surface effects, most commonly conjunctival hyperemia.
